name: Stock Correction Report
query:
WITH RankedStockCorrections AS (
    SELECT
        a.item_code,
        a.item_name,
        a.uom,
        a.qty,
        b.warehouse AS warehouse,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.item_code, b.warehouse
            ORDER BY b.posting_date DESC, b.posting_time DESC, b.creation DESC
        ) AS latest_entry_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.item_code, b.warehouse
        ) AS correction_count
    FROM `tabStock Correction` b
    INNER JOIN `tabStock Correction Item` a ON (
        a.parent = b.name
    )
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.branch = %(branch)s
    )
    WHERE
        b.branch = %(branch)s
        AND (
            %(warehouse)s IS NULL
            OR %(warehouse)s = ''
            OR b.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
        )
        AND b.docstatus = 1
        AND (
            (
                (rs.hours IS NULL OR rs.hours = 0)
                AND b.posting_date = %(date)s
            )
            OR (
                rs.hours > 0
                AND TIMESTAMP(
                    b.posting_date,
                    b.posting_time
                ) <= TIMESTAMP(
                    DATE_ADD(%(date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
                    CONCAT(
                        LPAD(rs.hours, 2, '0'),
                        ':00:00'
                    )
                )
                AND TIMESTAMP(
                    b.posting_date,
                    b.posting_time
                ) >= TIMESTAMP(
                    %(date)s,
                    CONCAT(
                        LPAD(rs.hours, 2, '0'),
                        ':00:00'
                    )
                )
            )
            OR (
                rs.branch IS NULL
                AND b.posting_date = %(date)s
            )
        )
)
SELECT
    item_code AS "Item Code",
    item_name AS "Item Name",
    ROUND(
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN latest_entry_rank = 1
                THEN qty
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ),
        3
    ) AS "Quantity",
    MAX(uom) AS "UOM",
    warehouse AS "Warehouse",
    MAX(correction_count) AS "Corrections"
FROM RankedStockCorrections
GROUP BY
    item_code,
    warehouse
ORDER BY
    item_code,
    warehouse;
